## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(magrittr)

data1 <- read_csv("~/Mass_Arrests (1).csv")

names(data1) <- trimws(names(data1))

data1$Race <- as.factor(data1$Race)
data1$Sex  <- as.factor(data1$Sex)

data_clean <- data1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(Race), !is.na(Sex))
```

```{r}
RaceSex_table <- table(data_clean$Race, data_clean$Sex)

RaceSex_table

RaceSex_pct <- prop.table(RaceSex_table, margin = 2) %>%
  round(., 3)

RaceSex_pct

```

```{r}
RaceSex_df <- as.data.frame(RaceSex_table)
names(RaceSex_df) <- c("Race", "Sex", "counts")
RaceSex_df$pctCol <- 100 * as.data.frame(RaceSex_pct)[,3]
```

```{r}
ggplot(RaceSex_df,
       aes(x = Sex, y = pctCol, fill = Race)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Arrests by Race within Sex",
    x = "Sex",
    y = "Percentage (%)",
    fill = "Race"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

covid <- read_csv("~/covid-19.csv")

covid$date <- as.Date(covid$date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")

covid <- covid %>%
  filter(!is.na(daily_cases_mean),
         !is.na(daily_deaths_mean),
         !is.na(Entity))


```

```{r}
covid_monthly <- covid %>%
  mutate(yearMonth = format(date, "%Y-%m-01")) %>%
  group_by(yearMonth) %>%
  summarise(
    cases = sum(daily_cases_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    deaths = sum(daily_deaths_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

covid_monthly$yearMonth <- as.Date(covid_monthly$yearMonth)
```

```{r}

ggplot(covid_monthly, aes(x = yearMonth, y = cases)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly COVID-19 Cases Over Time",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Cases"
  ) +
  theme_light()
```

```{r}
library(reshape2)

covid_long <- melt(covid_monthly,
                   id.vars = "yearMonth",
                   variable.name = "type",
                   value.name = "value")
```

```{r}
ggplot(covid_long, aes(x = yearMonth, y = value, color = type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "COVID-19 Cases and Deaths Over Time",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Count",
    color = "Variable"
  ) +
  theme_light()
```

```{r}

ggplot(covid_monthly, aes(x = cases, y = deaths)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  labs(
    title = "Relationship Between COVID-19 Cases and Deaths",
    x = "Cases",
    y = "Deaths"
  ) +
  theme_light()
```

```{r}


library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

data2 <- read.csv("Mass_Arrests (1).csv")

names(data2) <- make.names(names(data2))

str(data2)


data2_clean <- data2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(Arrest.Type),
         !is.na(Age))

data2_clean$Arrest.Type <- as.factor(data2_clean$Arrest.Type)


tapply(data2_clean$Age,
       data2_clean$Arrest.Type,
       summary)


ggplot(data2_clean, aes(x = Arrest.Type, y = Age)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.2, color = "blue") +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_light() +
  labs(title = "Age Distribution by Arrest Type",
       x = "Arrest Type",
       y = "Age")


ggplot(data2_clean, aes(x = Arrest.Type, y = Age)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "orange", trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1) +
  theme_light() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Age by Arrest Type",
       x = "Arrest Type",
       y = "Age")


summary_data <- data2_clean %>%
  group_by(Arrest.Type) %>%
  summarise(
    median_age = median(Age),
    max_age = max(Age)
  )

print(summary_data)

```

```{r}
ggplot(data2_clean, aes(x = Arrest.Type, y = Age)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "orange", trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1) +
  theme_light() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Age by Arrest Type",
       x = "Arrest Type",
       y = "Age")

```

```{r}
summary_data <- data2_clean %>%
  group_by(Arrest.Type) %>%
  summarise(
    median_age = median(Age),
    max_age = max(Age)
  )

print(summary_data)
```

```{r}
library(tidyr)

summary_long <- summary_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(median_age, max_age),
               names_to = "stat",
               values_to = "value")
```

```{r}
ggplot(summary_long,
       aes(x = Arrest.Type, y = value, color = stat)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  theme_light() +
  labs(title = "Median vs Max Age by Arrest Type",
       x = "Arrest Type",
       y = "Age",
       color = "Statistic")
```
